items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: That's the Pete Lala's band... We played for him.

ctx.x: Is this a picture of the band? One of the bands? One. Uh-huh. That's the Pete Lala's band. Well, we have a picture there, Mr. I'm grieving. Tell him, sir. Who all is in that?
He ought to know. I don't know if you recognize them.

items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: Eddie Jackson, Peter La Caz. And who had, I don't know what was it, Paul's band? Or, what? Heisenbaum. Heisenbaum. ... I played with the Nola band. You remember that. You played. You played with the band.

ctx.x: He's still over in Algiers. He still plays in the Eureka band with your son Percy quite often. Peter does.
Yeah, Pete told me he's 71 years old. I didn't know he was that. I didn't realize, I'll show you, I didn't realize he was that old.
